notes: Flameless-jets pass, hand-recorded via the flameless scratch tools (no Build-NacelleJets CONFIG entry, no mesh change). The wing pods CEM11WGL/CEM11WGR (mesh bones CEM11WGL0/WGR1) are separate parts off the body, so they become class 67 nacelles. Each carries one class 75 flame at the ribbed rear nozzle: -Z faces of the posed Assets/ModelFixes mesh span x +-3.08..3.73, y 0.37..1.96, z -3.9..-4.25; flame at (x +-3.40, y 1.10, z -4.10), pointing -Z. Positions are local to the pod in the VDF frame.
The body's three lit rear panels are part of CEM11BDA and are left unflamed (no carrier).

The missile and shield hardpoints CEM11GM1/GM2/GS1/GS2 sit on the pods but are parented to CEM11BDA, so the pods must not pitch: ODF/cvhtnk.odf and its baseName variants cvhmpa/cvhmpb carry all four pitch*Nacelle* keys at 0. With zero gains only the restoring term drives the gimbal (1.5 decompile all_decompiled.c 193665-193668), so the pods stay flat while the flames still scale with throttle (class 67 parent, 193771-193776).
No hardpoint receipt exists for cvhtnk; smoke CEM11SML/SMR stay on the pods.
